_purpose: Keywords and concepts the Opus-generated CFO briefing MUST surface for the EEI fixture. The test verifies these substrings appear (case-insensitive) in the briefing body.

must_contain_any_of_each_group._note: Briefing MUST quote operational revenue (706 only), NOT the inflated 4.89M total that includes 722. Accept rounded / formatted variants.

_optional_groups_note: These appear via the structured alerts surface (see expected_validation.must_flag). Not required in the 3-sentence briefing — they live in the Decisions / Alerts surfaces.

must_NOT_contain.rationale: If 722 is incorrectly included in revenue the briefing will quote 4.89M. That's the failure mode.
EEI has zero inventory. Any inventory advice is generic-finance-template noise.
For a real-estate holding the working capital cycle is irrelevant. Focus must be on LTV, DSCR, occupancy.

structural_requirements._followups_note: Trailer line must be present (and stripped from display) for the chip buttons.
